packet.scope: Clocked synchronous-RAM packet consumer; independent host float/RNE packet oracle, backpressure, captured context and zero-output fallback. No complete-frame performance or physical fit claim.

fetch.scope: Standalone two-word AXI prefetcher. Bounded original command fetch, captured source/count, address and command backpressure, error handling and cancellation drain. Shared-master arbitration remains integration work.

engine.scope: Actual baseline raw LOAD, DMA, transform/light, reciprocal and shared exact culler under bounded controller; synthetic contexts; no GPU/frame timing claim.

chain.scope: Actual baseline LOAD/DMA/shared FMA/culler plus actual packet converter, synthetic contexts, original TRI input, ordinary GPU packets with randomized backpressure; no GPU raster/frame timing or live-scene context claim.

stream-control.scope: Actual baseline LOAD/DMA/shared FMA/culler plus actual packet converter, directed sequential-AXI ownership/cancel/prefetch-drain/late-RLAST/recovery tests. No GPU raster/frame timing claim.
